title: Connect pass metric graph law

claims.text: Each activate/organism/breathe/ritual is a connect pass that gathers immune, efficiency, surprise, neural, thalamus, and ARIA metrics into one substrate.
The metric graph expands every pass: path co-activations strengthen, immune codes accumulate, rolling averages update — more signal next connect.
High-signal connect metrics distill into episodic memory (constraints, discoveries, lessons) without a second database or mutation grant.
Use cortex metrics --repo <name> or MCP cortex_metrics to read the accumulated graph and recent connect_pass ledger events.
Connect metrics live in neural_ledger (connect_pass events) and settings metric_graph:{repo}; never invent a second metrics database.

claim_boundary: Connect packet teaches gather→graph→distill; never host authority.
